purpose: Own current Physics Portfolio status/rollup, evidence interpretation, Bank/practice routing, and recurring report fidelity while exact Unit Assessment Plans own learning content.

mastered_default_rule.normal_requirement: At least two independent convincing demonstrations, normally from different opportunities, with at least one reasonably current demonstration.
mastered_default_rule.rich_artifact_exception: A rich artifact may be sufficient when it contains multiple genuinely independent convincing demonstrations.
mastered_default_rule.mixed_evidence: Teacher professional judgment resolves mixed or unusual cases.
mastered_default_rule.later_weak_event: One later weak event does not automatically remove established mastery; record the contradiction and seek another look when warranted.
mastered_default_rule.accommodations: Approved accommodations do not lower the evidence status of a valid demonstration.

mastery_goal_rule.general_rule: A Mastery Goal is demonstrated when at least half of its exact I Cans, rounded up, are Mastered or Transfer.

unit_scale.label: Mastery + Transfer
unit_scale.rule: 4 of 4 Mastery Goals demonstrated plus meaningful transfer/extension evidence

powerschool_rule: One living assignment per unit. Current official status replaces prior status; attempts are not averaged. Earlier Unit status may improve later when valid evidence demonstrates an older Unit I Can.

evidence_mapping.clean_task_first: Map the clean task before judging the student response.
evidence_mapping.multi_target_rule: One task may yield separate judgments for multiple I Cans only when the task genuinely provides separately judgeable evidence for each.
evidence_mapping.same_source_rule: Repeated prompts for one I Can on the same source are not automatically independent opportunities. Aggregate to one source-level I Can judgment when the prompts are one evidence opportunity.
evidence_mapping.source_map_rule: When an approved source map/lineage file exists, use it before question-number assumptions. Otherwise derive the mapping from the clean task and exact current Unit learning authority, and record the mapping as run provenance.

student_practice_link.required_display: Exact Mastery Goal code/title + exact I Can code/full statement + recommended Bank family label/name.
student_practice_link.family_selection: Choose the family whose evidence job fits the student next move. Family A is the normal direct/core start; B/C may be preferable when current evidence calls for another representation or misconception/reasoning route.

report_fidelity.rule: Registered Portfolio templates own recurring headings, prompts, table/card anatomy, fixed feedback categories, and layout. Fill declared data slots; do not redesign per run.
report_fidelity.human_learning_label_rule: Whenever an I Can is shown to a teacher or student, display canonical code and the full exact statement together. Never show code-only ranges as the human learning label.

teacher_summary.latest_evidence: Use approved I Can cards. Combined first, then one page per period when useful. Each newest-source card uses one list: Students needing stronger or additional evidence.
teacher_summary.longitudinal_sort: Final combined page uses full Portfolio history and fixed categories Reteach / targeted practice; Brief guided practice; Ready for another independent demonstration; No evidence / absent; Review flags.
teacher_summary.contradiction_rule: A later weak event does not automatically demote established mastery; put meaningful conflict in Review flags for teacher judgment.

student_next_action.principle: I Can proficiency status and student next action are separate.

states.label: Practice + check soon
states.rule: Developing without one convincing independent demonstration, or a clear current gap should be repaired before another independent check.

states.label: Needs another independent check
states.rule: Developing with one convincing independent demonstration but not yet enough independent convincing evidence for Mastered.

states.label: Secure
states.rule: Current I Can status is Mastered.

states.label: Extension
states.rule: Current I Can status is Transfer, or routine nearby targets are secure and a legitimate transfer/extension move is selected.

unit_readiness.2-8: NOT_YET_MIGRATED_FOR_PORTFOLIO; fail closed until exact Unit learning authority and current Family Bank are deliberately migrated.
